metadata.notice: Usage is simulated. Checks use the selected checker; see per-task outcomes.
metadata.token_definition: input (including cached input) + output; summed over steps per task
metadata.cost_definition: USD estimates from configured prices; cached tokens are an input subset
metadata.cache_policy: cold per task/mode; fake full stable-prefix hits are scoped to model
metadata.paired_difference: tokentrim - baseline; pass-rate differences are proportions
metadata.percent_saving: 100 * (mean baseline - mean tokentrim) / mean baseline; undefined at zero
